strings: r_c0 sighs as yet another fuming cat comes in complaining about m_c 'mocking' them with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} parroting behaviour.
m_c has been cheerfully mimicking {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} various Clanmates as a way to show more affection.
As a way to keep in control of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} words, m_c has been parroting {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates.
m_c finds it incredibly funny how some of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates overreact to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} parroting words.
